prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 个人所得税专项附加扣除标准简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "扣除项目" spans 1 col × 2 row; "每月标准（元）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "适用条件" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "扣除项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "每月标准（元） › 一般地区" · longest unbreakable word 37px · one-line width 203px
  col 3: header "每月标准（元） › 特殊情形" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 435px
  col 4: header "适用条件" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 1038px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 440px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 439px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"概览个人所得税专项附加扣除项目、每月标准及适用条件，帮助读者查找相关扣除。","reading":"先按首列找到扣除项目，再横向比较一般地区与特殊情形的标准，并阅读适用条件；每行应保持清晰的整体。","groups":["第二、三列同属每月标准，应便于并排比较；第三列的特殊情形说明也与第四列的适用条件相互关联。"],"keep_intact":["扣除金额及其单位","项目名称中的关键短语","一般地区和特殊情形的列标题"],"may_wrap":["较长的扣除项目名称可按自然词组换行","金额后的地区或家庭情形说明","适用条件中的完整句子；同一行其他单元格可利用该行已有高度换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [94, 85, 91, 169] · table 440×1198px · row heights [36, 36, 176, 153, 199, 199, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [88, 82, 89, 180] · table 440×1128px · row heights [36, 60, 176, 153, 176, 176, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [92, 80, 96, 171] · table 440×1221px · row heights [36, 60, 176, 153, 199, 199, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"两个标准子表头均保持一行，首列项目名称较容易辨认，行之间的对应关系清楚。","problems":"适用条件多次占满八行，后四个数据行尤其高；特殊情形中的说明也被切成许多短行，横向比较时不够顺畅。","cause":"第四列169px，对最长的条件句偏窄；第三列91px也限制了金额后说明的连续性。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"第四列较宽，条件文字多数降至七行，行高更紧凑；标准列仍可并排比较。","problems":"“一般地区”表头换行，破坏了两个子表头的平行关系；“3岁以下婴幼儿照护”在首列末尾孤留一个“护”字，项目名称不易整体识别。","cause":"第二列82px不足以容纳表头单行，首列88px也不足以让较长项目名称自然分成两行；第四列180px占用了前两列所需的空间。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"首列较宽，长项目名称分行较完整；第三列96px使“1100或800”等内容更集中，便于查看特殊情形金额。","problems":"“一般地区”表头换行，与相邻表头不齐；适用条件仍有多处八行，整体较高，第三列增加的宽度未能改善主要行高。","cause":"第二列80px过窄；第三列增至96px后，第四列只有171px，条件文字仍然拥挤。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-header","widths":[94,85,89,171],"change":"以r2A为基础，保留首列和一般地区表头的单行空间，将特殊情形缩小2px并让给适用条件，检验能否减轻条件列拥挤。"},{"name":"conditions-priority","widths":[92,85,85,177],"change":"恢复一般地区表头所需宽度，首列保留较完整的项目名称，将更多空间分配给适用条件；检验特殊情形列收窄后的可读性与行高。"},{"name":"special-case-balance","widths":[90,85,94,170],"change":"在保持一般地区表头单行的前提下，给特殊情形较多空间，尝试让金额及其说明更连贯，并观察首列长项目名称是否出现孤字。"}]}
